facts.rationale: Corrects the omitted owner-equality guard and makes the removal predicate's polarity and pointer-validation limits explicit without changing supported visibility behavior.
facts.value: Reads xDAC_itcmd_var0 and updates JOBJ_HIDDEN on the root JObj's child subtree: zero shows it and nonzero hides it. Reads xDD4_itemVar.nessbat.x0 as the stored fighter reference and, when present, passes it to ftNs_AttackS4_CheckNessBatRemove. If that predicate returns true, or the stored reference is absent, the callback enters cleanup and returns true to request termination. Cleanup calls ftNs_AttackS4_ItemNessBatSetNULL only when the stored fighter is non-null and equals ip->owner; it clears the item's stored fighter reference and generic owner even when that equality fails. Otherwise the callback returns false. The fighter predicate checks AttackS4 membership and whether the fighter tracks any bat, not whether its tracked pointer equals this article.
